test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which Article deals with protection of life and personal liberty?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 21__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__Article 21:

__
 
• According to Article 21, no person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to the procedure established by law.
 
• The Supreme Court reiterated in the Menaka Gandhi v. Union of India case, that the Right to Life and Liberty cannot be deprived merely based on the procedure established by law. 
 
• It can not be suspended even during a National emergency.
 
• It is available to both citizens and non-citizens but not to enemy aliens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__Important Rights included under Article 21:

 
• Right to privacy
 
• Right to education
 
• Right to go abroad
 
• Right to shelter
 
• Right to pollution-free water and air
 
• Right against public hanging
 
• Right against custodial death
 
• Right against handcuffing
 
• Right to health
 
• Right to food
